note: Invented products and invented findings for the desktop pictures, beside the e-bike in examples.json. E-bike K and E-bike T are the two that sit next to it in Compare; where a title repeats a finding of the first e-bike it is the same finding, so Compare can say it is shared. Nothing here assesses a real brand.

claims.title: Battery range drops by a third after two winters
claims.body: Owners of the 2021 model report the same loss of range after two winters outdoors. The cells are the same ones the 2022 model uses.
claims.advice: Ask for the charge-cycle count and the range on the last ride.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: Lost about a third of the range by the second spring. Stored outside.

sources.title: Bike magazine long-term test
sources.quote: Two winters in, the range was down by about a third.

claims.title: Frame cracks beside the rear rack weld
claims.body: Several owners found a hairline crack where the rack bracket is welded to the frame, usually after carrying a heavy load. A cracked frame is not repairable.
claims.advice: Look closely at the weld under the rack, and ask whether the bike carried loads.

sources.title: Safety notice
sources.quote: Inspect the rack bracket weld for cracks before each ride.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: Found a hairline crack at the rack weld. The shop would not repair the frame.

sources.title: Used-bike buying guide
sources.quote: Check the rack weld on a 2021 K for cracks, especially if it carried loads.

claims.title: Brake pads are a six-month item
claims.body: The service manual calls for new pads every six months of daily commuting. Original pads on a two-year-old bike mean the brakes were not serviced.
claims.advice: Ask which pads are on it and when the brakes were last bled.

sources.title: Service manual
sources.quote: Replace the brake pads every six months of daily use.

sources.title: Dealer notice
sources.quote: Pads are a six-month item for daily commuting.

claims.title: The charger stops working after about a year
claims.body: A few owners report the original charger failing around the first anniversary. A replacement is sold separately.
claims.advice: Ask whether the original charger comes with it, and that it still works.

sources.title: Review
sources.quote: The charger died after eleven months. A new one was not cheap.

claims.title: Display shows a sensor error on cold starts
claims.body: On the first cold start of the day the display can show a sensor error that clears after a restart.
claims.advice: Ask to see it start from cold.

sources.title: Owner forum thread
sources.quote: Sensor error on the first start when it is under five degrees. Switch it off and on and it is fine.

claims.title: The kickstand bolt works loose
claims.body: The kickstand bolt loosens with vibration and can drop out. It is a five-minute fix with thread-lock.
claims.advice: Check the bolt is tight and ask whether thread-lock was used.

sources.title: Review
sources.quote: Lost the kickstand bolt on a bumpy road. Easy fix, annoying.
